rationale: Round 1 built and passed, so this candidate pushes obfuscation strength up while keeping hot-loop cost bounded. The program is a small numeric kernel (Jacobi/QR eigensolver) whose hot functions (Jacobi, QRiterate, Trianglelise, DivideAndSolve) are loop-heavy, so SUB stays near-max (cheap, always-safe arithmetic diversification), and IBR/ICALL are raised to disrupt control-flow and call-graph recovery at modest runtime cost, while BCF and FLA are raised only moderately (0.70/0.75) with RuntimeCost/SizeCost held around 0.45-0.55 so the selector applies them selectively to the largest functions rather than everywhere, bounding overhead in the inner eigenvalue loops. SPLIT and IGV are cheap structure/diversity enhancers kept high on DiversityGain to compound with the other passes. CorrectnessRisk weights stay low across the board since the previous candidate showed no ICE or miscompilation, leaving headroom for the stronger settings.
